items.description: Mydentify is a permanent product directory (free permanent listings) with one community-signaled product leaderboard each week; members also vote/signal which intent becomes a future leaderboard. Began as a web directory in 2004, rebuilt in 2026.

A one-time Player Pass permits weekly leaderboard entry/eligibility but never buys signals, rank, placement or a win; standings use valid member signals only. Sponsored placements are labeled advertising, separate from rankings.

Directory Score is Mydentify's composite comparison metric; Domain Rating is only one input. Users should verify pricing, eligibility, link behavior and status on the destination directory site before acting.
Pricing page: free permanent listings and the one-time Player Pass for weekly leaderboard eligibility

Product directory catalog comparing places to list a product by Directory Score, category, pricing, link type and Domain Rating (with collections such as SaaS, AI tools, indie makers, developer tools, free)
Products page: find products by practical use case
Homepage / current weekly leaderboard with standings, entry window and next-intent ballot
Free no-signup tools (e.g. directory finder, dofollow checker, llms.txt checker, AI cost calculator, x402 checkers), each with an appended /llms.txt guide, plus topical tool hubs
Weekly product leaderboards at /leaderboards/{topic}-{date}, each with status (locked/completed)
Articles/guides on startup directories, link authority, Domain Rating, PageRank and AI discovery, each with a Markdown version
Published intent pages (what a person wants to accomplish, e.g. get first users, accept payments), with llms.txt representations
Approved product profiles in Markdown via /api/products/{slug}/markdown (HTML at /products/{slug})
OpenAPI document for the public read-only API (human guide at /developers)
Structured JSON catalogs: products, directories, leaderboards and intents
